items.title: Restore intelligence-first cognition and remove encoded trading strategy from the hot path
acceptance: The hot-path profile contains no fixed strategy recipe, quota, hidden gate, or account-size-specific action rule.
Capacity and supported actions remain authoritative from the current Glitch packet and user configuration.
Source contracts and the full profile suite preserve the intelligence-first boundary.
items.stop_line: Do not replace removed recipes with another strategy, score, quota, or hidden gate.

items.title: Native acceptance of deterministic session observation memory
acceptance: The direct worker accumulates bounded session observations and exposes them as measured evidence only.
Missing or warming observations remain neutral uncertainty and cannot select or veto an action.
A named native Sim session proves the observation block remains evidence-only.
items.stop_line: Do not convert deterministic observations into action selection, sizing, geometry, entry, amendment, exit, or veto behavior.

items.title: Export and accept the current Glitch main plus current Hermes profile main pair
acceptance: The profile export is built from the current Hermes profile main distribution version.
The exported profile is paired with the current Glitch main AddOn source, not inferred from an older download catalog row.
Install/update, paused-first jobs, status, cognition, delivery, learning, reset, restart continuity, controls, and native receipts pass on the target Windows/NinjaTrader machine.
The operator explicitly promotes the named exported pair.
evidence: Current profile main is identified by its canonical branch in extensions.source_authority.
Current Glitch source authority is D:/ab/worktrees/glitch-nt-rebuild on main.
scripts/setup.ps1 and SHA256SUMS define the profile export integrity boundary.
items.notes: Native Glitch acceptance remains represented in the Glitch main ledger; cross-repository ticket IDs are not used as local Rail dependencies.
items.stop_line: No beta-ready, unattended, profitability, or live-capital claim before the current exported pair passes native acceptance.

extensions.canonical_rule: Current source canon is the current main branch of each repository. Export and download catalog state is separate until a new pair is exported.
